name: family-rules-cases
how_to_use: Every package copies this file byte for byte into its tests and pins its sha256; a copy that differs fails the test run.
HC Field (lib/job-family.js, lib/calendar-check.js), HC App (index.html family rule) and the Claudia worker (Day P&L, reconfirmation, coconut guard) must pass family_cases and finding_words.

Jarvis must pass family_cases (its Python copy of the rule), day_reader_cases (job_days.invoice_days), count_rule_cases (supabase_sync.sync_job_days and the family count rule), attach_cases (qbo_link_watch) and close_cases (calendar_check).
Every name, email, id and amount here is synthetic. Never add a real client.

formats.money: US dollars with a comma and two decimals, from cents: 113794 -> $1,137.94
formats.day: weekday short, month short, day: 2026-12-01 -> Tue Dec 1
formats.day_prefix: Day N of M, only when the row is a live family member and M >= 2
formats.badge_join: parts joined with a comma and a space

rules.family: head = the order the extra days point at (orders.parent_order_id); live members = head and children whose stage is not cancelled and cancelled_at is null; N of M = position among live members sorted by delivery day then id.
rules.money_state: a child with no own invoice takes the head's state; any other row uses its own stage: invoiced -> invoice_sent, deposit_paid -> deposit_paid, paid_full -> paid, cancelled -> cancelled. A child whose head is cancelled -> job_cancelled. A row with job_day_origin set and no parent -> orphan_day.
rules.open_part: ', $X open' where X = sum of open_cents of the head's attachments that are live (not detached), not voided and read (open_cents not null), when X > 0. Shown on the head and on every live child, owner only.
rules.revenue_cents: head or lone: own total_cents (null = 0) + total_cents of live, not voided, read attachments. Child with no own invoice: 0. Child with its own invoice: its own total. A row whose own stage is cancelled, or job_cancelled, or orphan_day: 0.
rules.collected_cents: head or lone: deposit_cents + balance_cents (money RECEIVED, null = 0) + (total_cents - open_cents) of live, not voided, read attachments. Child with no own invoice: 0. A row whose own stage is cancelled keeps what it received (kept deposits, today's Home rule); job_cancelled and orphan_day: 0.
rules.pending_cents: head or lone, stage not cancelled: max(0, total_cents - received) + open_cents of live, not voided, read attachments. Child with no own invoice: 0. Cancelled: 0.
rules.coconuts: each row its own coconuts_qty (null = 0); never the whole invoice on the head of a family.
rules.in_prep: own stage in invoiced, deposit_paid, paid_full; not cancelled; and not job_cancelled or orphan_day.
rules.crew: crew_badge_prefix = Day N of M or null; crew_stage = the stage code the app's existing crew word is made from (the head's stage for a child with no own invoice); crew_addon_lines = line_names of live, not voided attachments, no amounts; crew never sees money words or amounts.

family_cases.about: lone invoiced order, nothing received: reads Invoice sent
two-day job, one undated invoice on day 1, day 2 linked by the owner (paid in full)
three-day job, paid main invoice, an attached add-on (cart rental) still open
F04 after the add-on is paid
a voided attachment and a detached attachment count nowhere
head with a deposit: the extra day reads Deposit paid
head invoiced with nothing received: the extra day reads Invoice sent
the head was cancelled (invoice voided): the extra day reads Job cancelled, leaves prep and raises a finding
one extra day was cancelled: M counts live days only
a rare extra day that holds its own fee invoice keeps its own money and adds Day N of M
one-day job with an open add-on: no day prefix, open part shown, crew sees the line name
an attachment Jarvis has not read yet (totals null) counts 0 until the read
an extra day whose head was deleted (link set to null by the foreign key): orphan, out of prep, finding

day_reader_cases.about: three coconut lines with their own service dates (set by the connector)

lines.description: Attendant 10 AM to 5 PM, Tue Dec 1

day_reader_cases.about: the same invoice after a Jarvis edit: every service date became the ship date; dated descriptions still split it
after a Jarvis edit with undated descriptions: service dates all equal the ship date and carry no day, so no split
undated descriptions but distinct service dates (a connector edit): the service dates decide
one coconut line naming two event days is ONE delivery: never split

lines.description: 35 for Wednesday 11/25 (3 PM) and 45 for Friday 11/27

day_reader_cases.about: one undated line and no ship date: no day at all
one undated line with a ship date: one day
two coconut lines where one line names two days and its service date is only the ship date: cannot split
two coconut lines on the same day are one day (summed)
a description date takes the year nearest the ship date (New Year)
the date shapes the reader accepts
a dated description wins over a service date that disagrees

count_rule_cases.about: undated two-day family already consistent: nothing to write
an old re-sync left the whole invoice count on day 1: the rule writes invoice minus extra days
the owner changed day 1 on purpose (totals agree): keep it, raise count_differs
families on, dated invoice, no extra days yet: create them and lower day 1
the same in report mode: nothing written, the report lists what on would do
hand-made extra days (fast lane) that match the dated invoice: adopted, origin kept, no count writes
hand-made days follow the client plan but the invoice still has days 1 and 2 swapped (totals agree): adopt, no writes, days_differ
families off, a Jarvis edit changed the total and day 3's line: existing days follow the dated lines, nothing is created
undated family where the extra days hold more than the invoice: keep everything, raise count_differs
keep_count (the change watch, totals agree): never writes counts, only findings
a lone order (no extra days) keeps today's behavior: an edit writes the invoice count

attach_cases.about: add-on (no coconuts), same email, ship date on the head's day: attach to the head
add-on dated on an extra day: matched through that day's head
fee-only invoice with exactly one booked order of that customer within 14 days of its date: attach as fee
fee-only invoice for a weekly client with two booked orders in the window: never guess
an invoice already attached is never merged onto a new open lead of the same email
families off: the add-on stays held exactly as today, nothing attached

close_cases.about: a complete run closes an open finding it did not see again
a run cut short leaves findings on subjects it never checked open, and sends no push
a run cut short still closes a finding on a subject it fully checked, but sends no push
a dismissed finding stays dismissed while its facts are the same and reopens when they change

rules: Row title: {client}, {day}. Row line: the words below. Never an email address, a phone number or a dollar sign (lib/needs-you.js rule); amounts appear only on the card sheet.
Every row has ONE action button (below) and one way to say it is fine (the second label, stored with the facts fingerprint; still_on is shown on the card).
{when} is 'today', 'tomorrow' or 'in N days' (New York day for ny, the market's own day otherwise).

day_link.words: No invoice on this day. It looks like day {n} of the {head_day} job (#{doc}).

days_differ.words: #{doc} and the calendar disagree on the coconuts by day.

days_undated.words: #{doc} has {k} coconut lines with no day on each line, so the calendar cannot split it.
days_undated.calls: copies: put the day in each coconut line on invoice {doc} (Nevada ship-to: Open card instead, edit through Claude)

day_of_cancelled_job.words: This is an extra day of a job that was cancelled. It is left out of prep.

addon_open.words: #{doc} for this job is still open.
addon_open.calls: the Got a check? sheet, then hc_ar_request record_payment

unlinked_invoice.words: #{doc} is on no job in the calendar.
unlinked_invoice.calls: job picker, then hc_order_invoice_attach action attach

unpaid_soon.words: Nothing received yet, and the job is {when}.
unpaid_soon.calls: the Got a check? sheet, then hc_ar_request record_payment

money_drift.words: The app's money for #{doc} differs from QuickBooks.

no_ship_date.words: #{doc} has no ship date, so the job is on no day.
no_ship_date.calls: copies: change ship date on {doc} to {day} (a head with extra days or a Nevada ship-to: Open card instead)

count_missing.words: No coconut count, and the job is {when}.

count_differs.words: The calendar has {count} coconuts for this job; #{doc} has {invoice_count}.

read_stale.words: The app's copy of #{doc} is older than the invoice.

no_time.words: No delivery time, and the job is {when}.

cut_review.words: The cut needs your check before prep.

address_placeholder.words: The delivery address has no real street.
address_placeholder.calls: copies: change the delivery address on {doc} to <street, city, state, ZIP> (Nevada ship-to: Open card instead)

stamp_not_needed.words: The invoice says unbranded, but the stamp still reads not ordered.

stamp_unknown.words: Branded job, no stamp recorded, and the job is {when}.
stamp_unknown.calls: sheet Ordered / Client sends die / Not needed, then hc_crm_set_stamp

logo_missing.words: Branded job, no logo file, and the job is {when}.

past_lead.words: This lead's day passed {k} days ago.

lead_date_vs_estimate.calls: opens the deal in HC App

market_check.words: The ship-to state is {state}, which is not the {market} crew's area.
